ranked.headline: Histology-anchored models link tissue morphology to spatial and multi-omics profiles
ranked.summary: Pathology foundation models now align whole-slide histology with genomic, transcriptomic, and spatial omics data across cohorts and tasks.

ranked.headline: Learned models map treatment-induced cell dynamics and therapy responses
ranked.summary: Sparse, heterogeneous biological data increasingly demand models that infer time-varying treatment effects on cell state and fate.

ranked.headline: Single-cell methods attribute regulation and communication to specific cell types
ranked.summary: Spatial, reference-based and sample-level single-cell tools now resolve communication and regulation at population and tissue scale.

ranked.headline: Computational models tested at the limits of their intended regime
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers benchmark structure predictors, enhanced sampling, and ML/MM methods to define where their outputs remain trustworthy.

ranked.headline: Machine learning models linked to specific molecular endpoints and selection steps
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications tie molecular ML architectures to named endpoints such as binding affinity, drug synergy, and protein stability.

ranked.headline: Graph and attention networks predict drug-target and protein-binding affinities
ranked.summary: Multimodal deep learning now fuses sequence, structure, and graph features to sharpen pairwise binding and interaction predictions.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic transmission models link host and vector parameters to outcomes
ranked.summary: Late-2025 work applies ODE, Petri net and inverse methods to a 2025 chikungunya outbreak, sparse epidemics and arbovirus host diversion.

ranked.headline: Biophysical simulations tie axon geometry and stimulation physics to functional readouts
ranked.summary: Resolved geometry and stimulation physics are now paired with functional readouts in multiscale simulations spanning single axons to whole brains.

ranked.headline: Scale-aware models fuse spiking, field-potential, iEEG, and MEG neural recordings
ranked.summary: Week-long clinical recordings and paired spike-LFP data are now used to pretrain and fuse multiscale neural representations.

ranked.headline: Geometric representations infer single-cell behavior in multicellular tissues
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method tie cell-level inference to explicit geometric or mechanical representations of tissue structure.

ranked.headline: Genome-resolved data redefine algal and microbial lineage boundaries
ranked.summary: Recent genome-resolved surveys define marine microbial ecotypes, deep-branching algal lineages, and coral genomic vulnerability across ocean and host systems.

ranked.headline: Multi-omics fusion models predict BRAF inhibitor sensitivity in cancer cell lines
ranked.summary: Attention-based multi-omics fusion with protein network embeddings now models BRAF inhibitor response in GDSC cell lines.

ranked.headline: Genome assemblies clarify taxane pathway origin and AT-rich isochore dynamics in fungi
ranked.summary: Four chromosome-level plant genomes and a de novo fungal assembly extend reference resources for specialized metabolism and genome architecture.

ranked.headline: Unmodeled growth and noise propagation bias inference in single-cell and gene networks
ranked.summary: Single-cell and gene-network inference increasingly depends on explicit treatment of growth, alignment, and noise propagation rather than mean behavior.

ranked.headline: Structure-based simulations resolve nucleic acid plasticity, binding and condensation
ranked.summary: Explicit structural models now probe nucleic acid folding, binding plasticity, and protein-DNA condensation across resolutions.

ranked.headline: Pooled imaging and barcoded screens infer gene function and single-cell lineage
ranked.summary: Pooled perturbation screens now pair morphological, barcoded, and imaging readouts with self-supervised models to infer function without predefined labels.

ranked.headline: Correcting platform offsets and missing values in methylation and genotype array data
ranked.summary: Biobank-scale studies now combine array platforms and incomplete data, making imputation and calibration modeling targets rather than preprocessing.

ranked.headline: Pretrained and embedding-based models classify viral and fungal genomic sequences
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply pretrained genomic models and embeddings to viral taxonomy, fungal barcoding, and eDNA annotation.

ranked.headline: Pretraining efficiency gains for DNA, RNA, and protein sequence models
ranked.summary: Pretraining costs for biological foundation models motivate data pruning, motif-aware tokenization, and substructure-aware encoders.

ranked.headline: Machine learning guides small-molecule prioritization and biological function prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a review apply machine learning to small-molecule design, drug response, and protein and plant annotation.

ranked.headline: Biologically structured representation learning across spatial and single-cell omics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair large-scale omics pretraining and graph methods with explicit biological structure for spatial and single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models of microbial interactions, infection kinetics and biofilm eradication
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend spatial and multiscale mechanistic models to microbial aggregates, within-host infection, and biofilm antibiotic control.

ranked.headline: Spectral and perturbation constraints on E/I network dynamics and criticality
ranked.summary: Analytic spectra, perturbation tests, and avalanche models now probe how E/I structure bounds criticality in neural populations.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked calling and classification tools for somatic, germline and rDNA variants
ranked.summary: Reference materials and cfDNA benchmarks now quantify how calling choices affect low-frequency variant detection.

ranked.headline: Protein networks and genetic variants link circulating proteins to cardiovascular risk
ranked.summary: Large multi-ancestry and proteomic genetic studies now resolve causal protein and transcript routes to myocardial infarction and aortic stenosis risk.

ranked.headline: Spatial structure tools extend evolutionary, interaction, and alignment analyses
ranked.summary: Recent preprints package structure-aware methods for evolutionary analysis, molecular dynamics ensembles, and complex-level alignment in accessible software.

ranked.headline: Reusable open tools standardize diverse omics and imaging data analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published benchmark release open tools for harmonized data access, search, and multi-omic deconvolution evaluation.

ranked.headline: New algorithms refine mutation attribution, chromatin tracing, and metastasis inference
ranked.summary: Recent publications apply optimization, attribution, and error-correction methods to sequencing, lineage, and chromatin imaging datasets.

ranked.headline: Computational methods map binding interfaces and validate protein structural models
ranked.summary: Ensemble docking, quantum descriptors, and spectral scoring now extend structure-based analysis of binding and structure validation.

ranked.headline: Learning-Guided Virtual Screening Yields Helicase and PLK2 Inhibitor Chemotypes
ranked.summary: Iterative deep learning and consensus interaction models are now producing micromolar and submicromolar inhibitors against a viral helicase and a…

ranked.headline: AMR genotype prediction errors trace to threshold calibration and sampling bias
ranked.summary: Benchmarks of genomic AMR prediction now expose threshold and population-structure errors alongside faster nanopore clinical workflows.

ranked.headline: Long-read and deep-learning profiles of retrotransposons and isoforms in neurodisease
ranked.summary: Long-read sequencing and deep learning on bulk RNA-seq now resolve transposon activity, isoform diversity, and cell-subtype dynamics in AD and neurodevelopment.

ranked.headline: Computational detection of cryptic and naturally variable exons from RNA-seq
ranked.summary: Sample-level RNA-seq methods now detect cryptic exons and catalog natural exon variation to support splicing-aware variant interpretation.

ranked.headline: Spectral modeling replaces fixed references in peptide and proteoform analysis
ranked.summary: Reference-free de novo sequencing and imputation-aware proteoform statistics arrive alongside higher-depth DIA-TMT workflows on Orbitrap Astral.

ranked.headline: Non-additive and federated GWAS methods for complex traits in diverse and biobank cohorts
ranked.summary: Recent work extends GWAS beyond additive models to non-additive effects, federated mixed-model analysis, and admixed populations.

ranked.headline: Spatial profiling of methylation, isoforms and transcripts resolves tissue cell states
ranked.summary: Spatial readouts are extending from transcripts to methylomes and polyadenylation isoforms, enabling quantitative tissue-level cell-state mapping.

ranked.headline: Uncertainty and incomplete observations reshape single-cell and gene network inference
ranked.summary: Preprints now quantify observation quality and uncertainty in cell-state manifolds, trajectories, and gene networks rather than relying on point estimates.

ranked.headline: Assessing provenance and quality of reference genome assemblies across taxa
ranked.summary: Large genome collections and new telomere-to-telomere references are being audited for quality before comparative use.
